subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Frivolity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Insignificance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"frivolity"** means lack of seriousness or sense; something that is not important or of little value. (मूर्खता, तुच्छता)

 
 
• **Example:** The meeting was filled with frivolity and lacked any real substance.
 
 
 
• **"Insignificance"** refers to the quality of being unimportant or trivial. (तुच्छता)
 
 
• **Example:** The insignificance of his comments was evident to everyone in the room.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Insignificance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consequence** (परिणाम): The result or effect of an action or condition.

 
 
• **Example:** Every decision has a consequence, so choose wisely.
 
 
 
• **Meaningful** (सार्थक): Having a serious, important, or useful quality or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** The conversation was deep and meaningful, touching on many important issues.
 
 
 
• **Substantial** (ठोस): Of considerable importance, size, or worth.
 
 
• **Example:** He made a substantial donation to the charity.
